label: Xi asks Trump directly whether America would resist over Taiwan
description: That the Chinese leader asked the American president directly whether he would stand in resistance if China moved, given as the substance of a meeting.
aliases: Will you stand in resistance if we

label: Catholic nuns weeping as liberation comes to Cuba
description: Women who looked like Catholic nuns weeping before the Lord as liberation came to set the Cuban people free, with an instruction to keep praying and watch what he is about to do with Cuba.
aliases: they looked like they're Catholic nuns
weeping before the Lord as there was liberation coming

label: A two year window in which the dragon is kept at bay
description: A two year window seen in which the president keeps China at bay by cracking a whip, with about two and a half years left of the term, after which the protection is not stated to hold.
aliases: trying to keep the dragon at bay, cracking his whip
It has about 2 and 1/2 years left

label: Rebuked for caring more about people's feelings than God
description: He reports being corrected and rebuked for being more concerned with people's feelings than with God, quoting the instruction to fear him and not them.
aliases: the Lord said fear me not them and he corrected me
I got rebuked again right then

label: The panda turns its back on Russia and gazes at Taiwan
description: A panda bear, said to be symbolic of a people, turning its back on the Russia and Ukraine war and gazing toward Taiwan saying it is our time. Later seen as an evil looking panda wrapped in its flag talking to the dragon and to North Korea, with Taiwan glowing in yellow lights and the panda licking its lips.
aliases: I saw panda turn its back upon Russia and Ukraine
It's very evil-looking panda. It's wrapped in their flag

label: Israel as an ugly baby and America as a cute one
description: Israel seen wrapped as a baby with a big tooth and curly hair on top that did not look cute, and America seen as a pretty Gerber style baby with a bow carrying the Israeli flag. He says he does not know what the tooth was about.
aliases: I saw Israel wrapped in a baby, and it had a big tooth
America looked real cute, like a little Gerber baby

label: A patriotic song heard playing across the country
description: A song heard about the lakes of Minnesota, the hills of Tennessee and the plains of Texas from sea to shining sea, which he hears playing on the radios and asks whether it is literal or symbolic.
aliases: From the lakes of Minnesota to the hills of Tennessee
Is that literal, Lord, is that symbolic?

label: Grim reaper hands with moss and webbing over Seattle
description: Two hands like a grim reaper's seen over Seattle with moss growing down them and webbing hanging off, clawing, described alongside what he calls a skeleton of the gods.
aliases: I saw over Seattle. I saw two hands that looked like grand reaper hands
moss growing down, webbing hanging down off of it
